title: First Release Channel Division (Split B — Endowment Priority)
summary: Proposed dividing the First Term release 50% Endowment, 30% Assembly, 0% Deferral, 20% Reserve. Not carried.

provisions.heading: Division
provisions.text: The First Term release is divided among the four channels as follows: Endowment, fifty per cent; Assembly, thirty per cent; Deferral, nil; Reserve, twenty per cent.

provisions.heading: Endowment issuance
provisions.text: The Endowment share is issued in equal individual claims to every adult human, freely transferable from issuance.

history.action: Filed and listed by the Bureau as Split B.
